blind.description: A humanoid figure tightly wrapped in thick, rope-like or web-like strands, lying horizontally on the ground. The bundle tapers at both ends, featuring a rounded wrapped head at one end and a small dark brown/black boot or foot protruding from the wrapping at the opposite end. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and sculpted with intertwined strands fused into a single mass without loose or floating fragments. The material has a light tan/beige fleshy or silken appearance with a subtle satin sheen.
blind.from_above: An elongated horizontal tapered bundle with layered strands wrapping around a body form, showing a protruding dark foot tip on the left and a rounded wrapped head on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Lying flat on the ground; height is about 1 ft (less than one-fifth of the figure's height), length is roughly 4.5 to 5 ft (slightly shorter than the figure is tall), and width is about 1.5 ft.

notes: height is slightly flatter than catalog target but realistic for a prone wrapped figure
